candidates.title: Unicode-Safe Model Router Transport
candidates.why: The live `/start` run proved `compact-handoff` can fail before startup finishes when `LATEST_HANDOFF.md` contains malformed UTF-16. JSON escaping alone is not enough because the upstream API rejects lone surrogate code units as invalid Unicode. The model-router chokepoint should clean transport payloads once, so every Studio OS script inherits the fix without papering over individual callers.
candidates.recipe: Add a recursive Unicode scalar sanitizer in `scripts/lib/model-router.mjs`, use it for Anthropic JSON payload serialization, and cover both lone high/low surrogates and valid emoji preservation with focused tests.
candidates.evidence: `node scripts/compact-handoff.mjs` failed during `/start` with `API error: The request body is not valid JSON: no low surrogate in string`. `scripts/lib/model-router.mjs` currently passes raw `JSON.stringify(body)` to the API, so any caller can reproduce the failure with malformed local text.

L2.recipe: Sanitize all model-router JSON payloads at the API chokepoint and add focused transport tests.

L3.recipe: Extend the sanitizer into semantic-cache keys and raw/batch API helpers, then add a startup smoke proving compact handoff survives malformed handoff text.

candidates.title: Codex Plan-Mode Truth
candidates.why: The startup verifier currently tells a Codex session to run `/model opusplan`, which Codex cannot execute. That is a lying operational surface: it burns attention, leaves the session lock marked missing, and makes future startup briefs look worse than reality. Restoring agent-aware `not_required` stamping keeps the protocol strict for Claude Code while keeping Codex sessions honest.
candidates.recipe: Restore `verify-plan-mode.mjs` session-agent detection and `not_required` lock/status stamping for non-Claude Code agents. Add a regression test that runs the script in a temp Codex project and verifies JSON output, `PROJECT_STATUS.json`, and `.session-lock` all agree.
candidates.evidence: `node scripts/write-session-lock.mjs --agent codex` followed by `node scripts/verify-plan-mode.mjs --quiet` emitted `⚠ MISSING` and asked for `/model opusplan`. The current diff in `scripts/verify-plan-mode.mjs` removed the non-Claude agent exception and stamping helper.

L1.recipe: Restore the non-Claude agent early return.

L2.recipe: Restore the early return plus status/lock stamping and focused regression coverage.

L3.recipe: Also add a protocol-drift check that fails if Codex sessions report Claude-only plan-mode missing.

skipped.reason: Rejected on verification: the compactor has a valid API-key path and real token-saving purpose. Disabling it would hide the malformed-Unicode transport bug instead of fixing the shared chokepoint.

executionLog.notes: Added recursive Unicode scalar sanitization at the model-router API chokepoint, reused it for messages/raw/batch payloads and semantic cache keys, and covered malformed high/low surrogates plus valid emoji preservation. Verified with focused Vitest coverage and `node scripts/compact-handoff.mjs --force`, which now succeeds after the original startup failure.

Restored session-agent detection in `scripts/verify-plan-mode.mjs` so Codex sessions stamp `not_required` instead of prompting for Claude Code `/model opusplan`. Verified with focused temp-project regression coverage and live `node scripts/verify-plan-mode.mjs --json` returning `not_required` for the current Codex lock.
